verdict.rationale: Mem0 docs confirm a CLI/API delete operation (add, search, list, update, delete) and entity-scoped memory that separates data by user/agent/app/session, which together enable targeted or per-entity deletion. However, there is no explicit documentation of a bulk 'erase all memories for a user' or GDPR-style full-erasure endpoint, and no independent verification that deletion is complete/irreversible (expiration_date docs even note 'nothing is deleted' for that feature). Missing for 10: explicit full-erasure/bulk-delete-by-user API documentation, independent confirmation of complete data removal, and privacy-compliance certification.
